preregistered_criteria.anti_floor_rule: Baseline K0 must achieve > 0% accuracy across the 16 items to ensure items are solvable and clear.
preregistered_criteria.anti_ceiling_rule: No single treatment arm (K0, K0D, K1, K2, K3) may achieve 100% accuracy on all 16 items in pilot evaluation, preventing saturation/ceiling effects.
preregistered_criteria.discriminative_range: Target overall accuracy across arms should span between 25% and 85%, ensuring sufficient dynamic range to evaluate differential methodology effects.
preregistered_criteria.cluster_variance_requirement: At least 3 of the 5 clusters must exhibit non-zero variance across arms.

consequence_of_gate_failure.floor_failure: If K0 = 0% and K1/K2/K3 = 0%, items are defectively ambiguous or unparseable. Items must be clarified before Freeze B.
consequence_of_gate_failure.ceiling_failure: If K1 = 100% and K2 = 100%, battery is classified as NON_IDENTIFYING_CEILING. Harder adversarial items must be introduced before Freeze B.
